```{r load-data}
# One row per lake: which saved model output to read. Add/remove lakes here.
lakes <- tibble::tribble(
  ~lake_key, ~output_file,
  "WLB",     "Data/model_outputs/WLB_2017_2024_output.csv",
  "ELB",     "Data/model_outputs/ELB_2017_2024_output.csv",
  "LH",      "Data/model_outputs/LH_2017_2024_output.csv",
  "LF",      "Data/model_outputs/LF_2017_2024_output.csv",
  "GL4",     "Data/model_outputs/GL4_2014_2025_output.csv",
  "LOC",     "Data/model_outputs/LOC_2017_2024_output.csv"
)

# Saved model output for each lake (named list: results$ELB, results$GL4, ...)
results <- lakes$output_file |>
  purrr::map(~ readr::read_csv(file.path(path, .x), show_col_types = FALSE)) |>
  purrr::set_names(lakes$lake_key)

# Matching ice-thickness observations for each lake, clipped to that lake's
# modelled period. load_ice_observations() applies the same lake/location
# filters as the 00_ prep scripts, but needs no met data.
ice_obs <- purrr::imap(results, function(res, key) {
  load_ice_observations(key, project_path = path,
                        time_range = range(res$time, na.rm = TRUE))
})

# Plot one lake: model vs observations. Saved CSVs don't keep the
# temperature-profile list columns, so that panel is switched off.
plot_lake <- function(key) {
  res <- results[[key]]
  plot_ice_model(
    res,
    ice_thickness     = ice_obs[[key]],
    title             = LAKE_CONFIGS[[key]]$lake_name,
    subtitle          = sprintf("%s – %s | %s",
                                format(min(res$time), "%Y-%m-%d"),
                                format(max(res$time), "%Y-%m-%d"),
                                if (nrow(ice_obs[[key]]) > 0)
                                  paste(nrow(ice_obs[[key]]), "ice-thickness observations")
                                else "no ice-thickness observations yet"),
    plot_temp_profile = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Ice thickness: all lakes

```{r all-lakes, fig.height = 13}
model_daily <- purrr::imap_dfr(results, function(res, key) {
  res |>
    dplyr::mutate(day = lubridate::floor_date(time, "day")) |>
    dplyr::group_by(day) |>
    dplyr::summarise(thickness = mean(thickness, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(lake = LAKE_CONFIGS[[key]]$lake_name)
})
obs_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(ice_obs, ~ dplyr::mutate(.x, lake = LAKE_CONFIGS[[.y]]$lake_name))

lake_levels <- purrr::map_chr(lakes$lake_key, ~ LAKE_CONFIGS[[.x]]$lake_name)
model_daily$lake <- factor(model_daily$lake, levels = lake_levels)
obs_all$lake     <- factor(obs_all$lake,     levels = lake_levels)

ggplot(model_daily, aes(day, thickness)) +
  geom_line(colour = "#2166ac", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = obs_all, aes(date_time, z_water_m),
             colour = "#d6604d", size = 1.4, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ lake, ncol = 1, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Ice thickness (m)",
       caption = "Line = modelled (daily mean); points = observed") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
